title.en: Korean Short Stories for Beginners 2
A Treasure in the Old Bookshop

lines.ko: 민수는 지난주에 조용한 새 동네로 이사했어요.
lines.en: Minsu moved into a quiet new neighborhood last week.

lines.ko: 짐 정리를 모두 마치고 동네 골목을 산책했어요.
lines.en: After finishing his unpacking, he took a walk along the neighborhood alleys.

lines.ko: 낡은 간판이 달린 작은 헌책방을 우연히 발견했어요.
lines.en: He stumbled upon a small secondhand bookstore with an old sign.

lines.ko: 문을 열고 들어가자 종이 냄새가 포근하게 풍겼어요.
lines.en: As he opened the door and walked inside, the cozy smell of old paper welcomed him.

lines.ko: 책방 구석마다 오래된 책들이 높게 쌓여 있었어요.
lines.en: Stacks of old books were piled high in every corner of the shop.

lines.ko: 민수는 조심스럽게 문학 책장을 둘러보았어요.
lines.en: Minsu carefully browsed through the literature shelves.

lines.ko: 먼지 쌓인 책들 사이에서 익숙한 소설책 한 권을 꺼냈어요.
lines.en: Among the dusty volumes, he pulled out a familiar novel.

lines.ko: 어릴 때 좋아했던 옛날 동화책이었어요.
lines.en: It was an old storybook that he had loved when he was a child.

lines.ko: 책장을 넘기자 첫 장에 짧은 손글씨가 적혀 있었어요.
lines.en: When he turned the page, he saw a short handwritten note on the very first page.

lines.ko: 소중한 친구에게 이 책을 선물한다는 따뜻한 글이었어요.
lines.en: It was a warm message saying this book was a gift for a cherished friend.

lines.ko: 민수는 이전 주인의 마음에 감동을 느꼈어요.
lines.en: Minsu felt deeply touched by the previous owner's warm heart.

lines.ko: 그는 그 책을 품에 안고 계산대로 향했어요.
lines.en: Holding the book in his arms, he walked over to the checkout counter.

lines.ko: 백발의 사장님이 미소를 지으며 책을 건네주셨어요.
lines.en: The white-haired owner smiled and handed the wrapped book to him.

lines.ko: 책방 문을 나서니 마음에 따뜻한 온기가 번졌어요.
lines.en: Stepping out of the bookstore, a gentle warmth spread through his heart.

lines.ko: 민수는 새 동네의 소중한 아지트를 찾아서 기뻤어요.
lines.en: Minsu was thrilled to have found a precious hideout in his new neighborhood.

check.q: Where did Minsu go for a walk after unpacking his things?
check.a: He went for a walk along the neighborhood alleys.

check.q: What did Minsu discover on the first page of the old storybook?
check.a: He discovered a short handwritten message for a friend.

check.q: How did Minsu feel after stepping out of the secondhand bookstore?
check.a: He felt happy to have found a precious hideout in his new neighborhood.

title.en: A Nervous First Day at Work

lines.ko: 지수는 오늘 새 회사로 첫 출근을 해요.
lines.en: Today was Jisu's very first day at her new company.

lines.ko: 어젯밤에 다려 둔 단정한 옷을 입었어요.
lines.en: She put on the neat suit that she had ironed the night before.

lines.ko: 거울을 보며 깊게 숨을 들이쉬고 용기를 냈어요.
lines.en: Looking in the mirror, she took a deep breath and gathered her courage.

lines.ko: 평소보다 삼십 분 일찍 집을 나섰어요.
lines.en: She left home thirty minutes earlier than usual.

lines.ko: 출근 시간 지하철에는 사람들로 가득 차 있었어요.
lines.en: The morning subway was packed with commuters.

lines.ko: 지수는 가슴이 두근거려서 손을 꼭 쥐었어요.
lines.en: Jisu's heart raced with nervous excitement, and she clutched her hands tightly.

lines.ko: 회사 건물 앞에 도착하니 커다란 유리문이 보였어요.
lines.en: When she arrived at the office building, she saw the large glass doors.

lines.ko: 사무실 문을 열고 들어가자 모두 바쁘게 일하고 있었어요.
lines.en: Stepping through the office doors, she saw everyone working busily.

lines.ko: 지수는 팀장님을 찾아가 긴장하며 인사했어요.
lines.en: Jisu walked up to the team manager and greeted him nervously.

lines.ko: 팀장님은 반갑게 웃으며 지수의 자리를 안내해 주셨어요.
lines.en: The team manager smiled warmly and showed Jisu to her new desk.

lines.ko: 책상 위에는 새 컴퓨터와 환영 편지가 놓여 있었어요.
lines.en: A brand new computer and a welcome card were sitting on the desk.

lines.ko: 옆자리 동료가 다가와 따뜻한 차 한 잔을 건넸어요.
lines.en: Her deskmate approached and offered her a warm cup of tea.

lines.ko: 첫날이라 떨리겠지만 천천히 배우면 돼요.
lines.en: It is normal to feel nervous on your first day, so take your time to learn.

lines.ko: 동료의 다정한 한마디에 긴장이 눈 녹듯 사라졌어요.
lines.en: Her colleague's kind words made all her anxiety melt away.

lines.ko: 지수는 밝은 미소를 지으며 업무를 시작했어요.
lines.en: With a bright smile on her face, Jisu began her work.

check.q: Why did Jisu leave home thirty minutes earlier than usual?
check.a: She left early because it was her first day at her new company.

check.q: What was waiting on Jisu's desk when she arrived?
check.a: A new computer and a welcome card were sitting on her desk.

check.q: How did Jisu feel after hearing her coworker's kind words?
check.a: Her coworker's kind words made all her nervous anxiety melt away.

title.en: Making My First Ceramic Mug

lines.ko: 하나는 토요일 오후에 도자기 공방을 찾아갔어요.
lines.en: Hana visited a pottery workshop on a Saturday afternoon.

lines.ko: 평소에 직접 만든 컵을 써 보고 싶었어요.
lines.en: She had always wanted to use a cup that she made with her own hands.

lines.ko: 앞치마를 두르고 둥근 물레 앞에 앉았어요.
lines.en: Putting on an apron, she sat down in front of the round potter's wheel.

lines.ko: 선생님이 부드러운 흙 반죽을 물레 위에 올려놓았어요.
lines.en: The teacher placed a soft lump of clay onto the wheel.

lines.ko: 물레가 빠르게 돌아가자 손에 힘이 들어갔어요.
lines.en: As the wheel spun quickly, her hands tensed up.

lines.ko: 조심스럽게 가운데를 누르자 흙이 비틀거렸어요.
lines.en: When she gently pressed the center, the clay wobbled out of shape.

lines.ko: 모양이 망가질까 봐 하나는 깜짝 놀랐어요.
lines.en: Hana gasped in surprise, worried that the shape would be ruined.

lines.ko: 선생님이 하나의 손을 감싸 쥐고 중심을 잡아주셨어요.
lines.en: The instructor wrapped his hands around hers and helped center the clay.

lines.ko: 숨을 고르고 천천히 손을 위로 올렸어요.
lines.en: Catching her breath, she slowly pulled her hands upward.

lines.ko: 흙이 점점 둥글고 예쁜 컵 모양으로 변했어요.
lines.en: The clay gradually transformed into a neat, round cup shape.

lines.ko: 컵 옆에 작고 귀여운 손잡이도 붙였어요.
lines.en: She also attached a cute little handle to the side of the cup.

lines.ko: 비록 조금 삐뚤어졌지만 세상에 하나뿐인 컵이었어요.
lines.en: Although it was slightly crooked, it was the only mug of its kind in the world.

lines.ko: 이 컵은 가마에서 두 번 구워야 완성돼요.
lines.en: This cup must be baked twice in the kiln to be finished.

lines.ko: 굽는 데 한 달이 걸린다는 말을 들었어요.
lines.en: She was told that the firing process would take about a month.

lines.ko: 하나는 완성된 컵을 받을 날을 손꼽아 기다렸어요.
lines.en: Hana eagerly looked forward to the day she would receive her finished cup.

check.q: Why did Hana visit the pottery workshop on Saturday?
check.a: She visited because she wanted to make her own cup by hand.

check.q: Who helped Hana when the spinning clay wobbled out of shape?
check.a: The instructor held her hands and helped center the clay.

check.q: How long would it take for the ceramic cup to be fired in the kiln?
check.a: The firing process would take about a month.

title.en: The Misdelivered Parcel

lines.ko: 민수는 퇴근하고 집 현관 앞에 도착했어요.
lines.en: Minsu returned home from work and arrived in front of his front door.

lines.ko: 문 앞에 커다란 택배 상자가 놓여 있었어요.
lines.en: A large delivery box was sitting outside his door.

lines.ko: 민수는 자신이 주문한 물건이 아니라서 의아했어요.
lines.en: Minsu was puzzled because he had not ordered anything recently.

lines.ko: 상자에 붙은 운송장을 자세히 살펴보았어요.
lines.en: He carefully inspected the shipping label on the package.

lines.ko: 받는 사람 주소에 옆집 오백이호가 적혀 있었어요.
lines.en: The delivery address had the neighboring apartment number, unit 502.

lines.ko: 택배 기사님이 주소를 착각해서 잘못 두고 가신 것이었어요.
lines.en: The delivery courier had made a mistake and left it at the wrong door.

lines.ko: 민수는 무거운 상자를 양손으로 번쩍 들었어요.
lines.en: Minsu lifted the heavy box up with both hands.

lines.ko: 옆집으로 걸어가서 조심스럽게 초인종을 눌렀어요.
lines.en: He walked over to the neighboring door and gently rang the doorbell.

lines.ko: 백발의 할머니가 문을 열고 밖을 내다보셨어요.
lines.en: An elderly grandmother opened the door and peered outside.

lines.ko: 이 상자가 저희 집 앞에 잘못 와 있어서 가져왔어요.
lines.en: This parcel was delivered to my door by mistake, so I brought it over.

lines.ko: 할머니는 기다리던 물건이라며 환하게 웃으셨어요.
lines.en: The grandmother smiled brightly, saying it was a package she had been waiting for.

lines.ko: 시골에 사는 딸이 보낸 신선한 사과 상자였어요.
lines.en: It was a box of fresh apples sent by her daughter living in the countryside.

lines.ko: 할머니는 고맙다며 방금 찐 백설기 떡을 건네주셨어요.
lines.en: The grandmother thanked him and handed him some freshly steamed rice cakes.

lines.ko: 이웃과 따뜻한 인사를 나누니 마음이 훈훈해졌어요.
lines.en: Sharing warm words with his neighbor filled Minsu's heart with warmth.

lines.ko: 민수는 달콤한 떡을 들고 기분 좋게 집으로 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: Carrying the sweet rice cake, Minsu happily returned to his apartment.

check.q: Why was Minsu puzzled when he saw the delivery box?
check.a: He was puzzled because he had not ordered any parcels recently.

check.q: What was inside the misdelivered package sent from the countryside?
check.a: Fresh apples sent by the grandmother's daughter were inside.

check.q: What did the elderly neighbor give to Minsu as a thank-you gift?
check.a: She gave him some freshly steamed rice cakes.

title.en: Jisu Opens a Bank Account

lines.ko: 지수는 이번 달에 첫 아르바이트 월급을 받았어요.
lines.en: Jisu received her very first part-time job paycheck this month.

lines.ko: 스스로 번 돈을 모으기 위해 은행을 찾아갔어요.
lines.en: She visited a bank to save the money she had earned on her own.

lines.ko: 은행 입구에서 번호표를 뽑고 대기석에 앉았어요.
lines.en: She took a numbered ticket at the entrance and sat down in the waiting area.

lines.ko: 전광판에 지수의 번호가 뜨자 창구로 다가갔어요.
lines.en: When her number flashed on the digital screen, she walked up to the counter.

lines.ko: 친절한 은행원이 미소를 지으며 무엇을 도와드릴까요 하고 물었어요.
lines.en: The friendly banker smiled and asked how she could help her today.

lines.ko: 지수는 저축을 위한 통장을 만들고 싶다고 말했어요.
lines.en: Jisu said that she wanted to open a savings account.

lines.ko: 은행원은 여러 적금 상품을 알기 쉽게 설명해 주었어요.
lines.en: The banker clearly explained several savings plans in easy terms.

lines.ko: 지수는 매달 조금씩 돈을 모으는 상품을 선택했어요.
lines.en: Jisu chose a plan where she would save a small amount of money each month.

lines.ko: 신분증을 보여주고 서류에 정성껏 이름을 적었어요.
lines.en: She showed her ID card and carefully wrote her name on the documents.

lines.ko: 서명을 마치자 은행원이 파란색 새 통장을 건네주었어요.
lines.en: Once she finished signing, the banker handed her a crisp blue bankbook.

lines.ko: 통장 첫 줄에 찍힌 지수의 이름을 보니 가슴이 뿌듯했어요.
lines.en: Seeing her name printed on the first line of the bankbook made her feel proud.

lines.ko: 앞으로 매달 열심히 저축하기로 굳게 다짐했어요.
lines.en: She firmly resolved to save diligently every single month from now on.

lines.ko: 은행 문을 나서는 발걸음이 한결 가볍고 신났어요.
lines.en: Stepping out of the bank doors, her walk was noticeably lighter and more cheerful.

lines.ko: 작은 돈이 모여 큰 꿈을 이룰 생각을 하니 설렜어요.
lines.en: She was excited thinking of how small savings would help achieve her big dreams.

lines.ko: 지수는 소중한 통장을 가방 안쪽에 소중하게 넣었어요.
lines.en: Jisu carefully tucked the precious bankbook deep inside her bag.

vocab.en: to resolve, to make up one's mind

check.q: Why did Jisu visit the bank today?
check.a: She visited the bank to open a savings account for her part-time earnings.

check.q: What did Jisu show to the banker to verify her identity?
check.a: She showed her ID card to the banker.

check.q: How did Jisu feel when she saw her name on the new bankbook?
check.a: She felt proud seeing her name printed on the bankbook.

title.en: Pancake Party on a Rainy Evening

lines.ko: 주말 오후에 하늘이 흐려지더니 굵은 빗방울이 떨어졌어요.
lines.en: On a weekend afternoon, the sky turned gray and heavy raindrops began to fall.

lines.ko: 하나와 민수는 창밖으로 내리는 비를 바라보았어요.
lines.en: Hana and Minsu looked out the window at the falling rain.

lines.ko: 빗소리를 들으니 고소한 김치부침개가 먹고 싶어졌어요.
lines.en: Listening to the sound of the rain, they craved savory kimchi pancakes.

lines.ko: 두 사람은 부엌으로 가서 냉장고를 열었어요.
lines.en: The two friends went into the kitchen and opened the refrigerator.

lines.ko: 잘 익은 김치와 신선한 대파, 부침가루를 꺼냈어요.
lines.en: They took out well-fermented kimchi, fresh green onions, and pancake flour.

lines.ko: 민수는 김치를 도마 위에서 잘게 썰었어요.
lines.en: Minsu chopped the kimchi into small pieces on the cutting board.

lines.ko: 하나는 커다란 볼에 찬물과 가루를 넣고 반죽을 저었어요.
lines.en: Hana put cold water and flour into a large bowl and stirred the batter.

lines.ko: 썰어 둔 김치를 반죽에 넣자 먹음직스러운 주황빛이 되었어요.
lines.en: When they added the chopped kimchi, the batter turned an appetizing orange color.

lines.ko: 달궈진 프라이팬에 식용유를 넉넉하게 둘렀어요.
lines.en: They generously poured cooking oil into the heated frying pan.

lines.ko: 국자로 반죽을 올리자 치이익 하는 맛있는 소리가 났어요.
lines.en: Laddling the batter onto the pan, a delicious sizzling sound filled the kitchen.

lines.ko: 빗소리와 부침개 굽는 소리가 마치 음악처럼 어울렸어요.
lines.en: The sound of the rain and the sizzling pancake matched like music.

lines.ko: 민수가 프라이팬을 흔들어 반죽을 한 번에 뒤집었어요.
lines.en: Minsu shook the pan and flipped the pancake over in a single motion.

lines.ko: 겉은 바삭하고 속은 부드러운 김치전이 완성되었어요.
lines.en: A kimchi pancake, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, was completed.

lines.ko: 둘은 식탁에 마주 앉아 따뜻한 전을 맛있게 나누어 먹었어요.
lines.en: Sitting across from each other at the table, they happily shared the warm pancake.

lines.ko: 비 오는 날 친구와 함께 요리하니 즐거움이 두 배가 되었어요.
lines.en: Cooking with a friend on a rainy day doubled their happiness.

check.q: What dish did Hana and Minsu crave while listening to the rain?
check.a: They craved savory kimchi pancakes.

check.q: What ingredients did they take out of the refrigerator?
check.a: They took out fermented kimchi, fresh green onions, and pancake flour.

check.q: How did the kimchi pancake turn out after Minsu flipped it?
check.a: It turned out crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.

title.en: A Weekend Morning Jog by the River

lines.ko: 민수는 건강을 위해 아침 일찍 운동화를 신었어요.
lines.en: Minsu laced up his running shoes early in the morning for his health.

lines.ko: 주말 아침이라 거리는 조용하고 공기는 상쾌했어요.
lines.en: Because it was a weekend morning, the streets were quiet and the air was crisp.

lines.ko: 민수는 가벼운 발걸음으로 한강 공원으로 걸어갔어요.
lines.en: Minsu walked to Hangang Park with a light stride.

lines.ko: 강변 산책로에는 이미 많은 사람들이 달리고 있었어요.
lines.en: Many people were already running along the riverside trail.

lines.ko: 민수는 무릎을 풀고 천천히 달리기 시작했어요.
lines.en: Minsu stretched his knees and slowly began to jog.

lines.ko: 시원한 아침 강바람이 이마에 맺힌 땀을 식혀주었어요.
lines.en: A cool morning river breeze cooled the sweat on his forehead.

lines.ko: 일 킬로미터를 지나자 숨이 차고 다리가 무거워졌어요.
lines.en: After the first kilometer, he grew short of breath and his legs felt heavy.

lines.ko: 멈추고 싶었지만 저 앞을 달리는 노인의 뒷모습을 보았어요.
lines.en: He wanted to stop, but saw an elderly man running steadily ahead of him.

lines.ko: 지치지 않고 일정한 속도로 달리는 모습이 멋졌어요.
lines.en: The sight of the elderly runner keeping a steady pace was inspiring.

lines.ko: 민수는 다시 힘을 내어 호흡을 고르고 속도를 맞추었어요.
lines.en: Minsu gathered his strength again, adjusted his breathing, and matched his pace.

lines.ko: 아침 햇살이 강물 위에서 반짝이며 눈부시게 빛났어요.
lines.en: The morning sunlight sparkled dazzlingly across the flowing river.

lines.ko: 마침내 목표했던 삼 킬로미터 완주 지점에 도착했어요.
lines.en: Finally, he reached his goal of finishing the three-kilometer run.

lines.ko: 온몸에 땀이 흘렀지만 가슴속이 상쾌하고 개운했어요.
lines.en: Sweat dripped from his body, but he felt refreshed and invigorated inside.

lines.ko: 민수는 벤치에 앉아 시원한 물을 마시며 숨을 돌렸어요.
lines.en: Sitting on a bench, Minsu drank cold water and caught his breath.

lines.ko: 스스로와의 약속을 지켜낸 뿌듯한 아침이었어요.
lines.en: It was a proud morning because he had kept his promise to himself.

title.en: A Warm Bowl of Gukbap on a Rainy Day

lines.ko: 우산이 없던 민수와 지수는 옷깃을 여미며 빠른 걸음으로 걸었어요.
lines.en: Without an umbrella, Minsu and Jisu pulled their collars tight and walked quickly.

lines.ko: 쌀쌀한 바람에 온몸이 오들오들 떨리고 손발이 차가워졌어요.
lines.en: The chilly wind made them shiver all over, turning their hands and feet cold.

lines.ko: 골목 모퉁이를 돌자 유리창 너머로 따뜻한 김이 피어오르는 식당이 보였어요.

lines.en: As they opened the door and entered, the rich aroma of simmering beef bone broth greeted them.

lines.ko: 두 사람은 따뜻한 온돌 자리로 안내받아 편하게 앉았어요.
lines.en: The two were guided to a warm heated floor seat and sat down comfortably.

lines.ko: 민수는 따끈한 소머리국밥 두 그릇을 주문했어요.

lines.ko: 잠시 후 뚝배기 속에서 보글보글 끓어오르는 맑은 국밥이 나왔어요.
lines.en: A moment later, the bubbling hot soup arrived in deep earthenware pots.

lines.ko: 아삭한 깍두기와 잘 익은 겉절이 김치도 상 위에 푸짐하게 차려졌어요.

lines.en: Taking a spoonful of the hot broth, their shivering bodies melted warmly inside.

lines.en: They mixed tender beef and rice into the broth and took big bites topped with radish kimchi.

lines.ko: 정직한 맛과 넉넉한 인심 덕분에 뚝배기 바닥이 훤히 드러났어요.
lines.en: Thanks to the hearty flavors and generous hospitality, they emptied their earthenware bowls to the bottom.

lines.ko: 든든하게 배를 채우고 식당 문을 나서니 비바람도 춥지 않았어요.
lines.en: Stepping out of the diner with full bellies, the rain and wind no longer felt cold.

lines.ko: 소박하지만 따뜻한 음식 한 그릇이 전해준 포근한 행복이었어요.

title.en: The Stair-Climbing Challenge

lines.en: Lately, Hana found herself out of breath when climbing stairs due to a lack of exercise.

lines.ko: 건강을 위해 오늘부터 매일 아파트 계단을 걷기로 결심했어요.
lines.en: For her health, she resolved to walk up the stairs of her apartment building every day starting today.

lines.ko: 퇴근 후 일층 엘리베이터 앞에서 망설이지 않고 비상계단 문을 열었어요.
lines.en: After work, she opened the emergency staircase door on the first floor without hesitation.

lines.ko: 서늘하고 조용한 계단실에 하나의 운동화 발소리가 또각또각 울렸어요.
lines.en: In the cool and quiet stairwell, the sound of Hana's sneakers echoed clearly.

lines.ko: 삼층까지는 가벼운 마음으로 경쾌하게 한 계단씩 올라갔어요.
lines.en: Up to the third floor, she climbed each step briskly with a light heart.

lines.ko: 하지만 오층을 넘어서자 종아리가 묵직해지고 땀이 솟아났어요.
lines.en: However, past the fifth floor, her calves grew heavy and sweat began to bead on her brow.

lines.ko: 칠층 계단참에서 잠시 멈춰 서서 난간을 잡고 숨을 몰아쉬었어요.
lines.en: She paused at the seventh-floor landing, holding onto the handrail to catch her breath.

lines.ko: 엘리베이터를 부르고 싶은 유혹이 마음속에서 강하게 일어났어요.
lines.en: A strong temptation to call the elevator arose in her mind.

lines.ko: 하지만 포기하지 않고 벽에 붙은 층수 표지판을 보며 다시 힘을 냈어요.
lines.en: However, refusing to give up, she gathered her strength as she looked at the floor sign on the wall.

lines.ko: 천천히 발을 디디며 한 층 한 층 목표를 향해 올라갔어요.
lines.en: Stepping slowly, she climbed floor by floor toward her destination.

lines.ko: 마침내 십층 계단 문을 밀고 복도로 나왔어요.
lines.en: Finally, she pushed open the tenth-floor door and stepped out into the hallway.

lines.ko: 이마에 흐르는 땀을 닦아내자 시원한 바람이 온몸을 스쳐 지나갔어요.
lines.en: As she wiped the sweat from her forehead, a cool breeze brushed past her body.

lines.ko: 다리는 후들거렸지만 스스로와의 약속을 지켰다는 성취감이 밀려왔어요.
lines.en: Her legs trembled slightly, but a wave of accomplishment swept over her for keeping her promise.

lines.ko: 현관문을 열고 집으로 들어서는 하나의 얼굴에 환한 미소가 번졌어요.
lines.en: Opening her front door and stepping inside, a bright smile spread across Hana's face.

lines.ko: 작은 실천이 모여 건강한 일상을 만든다는 소중한 믿음이 생겼어요.

title.en: Grandmother's Hand-Knitted Muffler

lines.en: On a Sunday when chilly early winter winds began to blow, Jisu visited her grandmother's country house.

lines.ko: 마당에 들어서자 할머니가 버선발로 뛰어나와 지수를 반갑게 안아주셨어요.
lines.en: As she stepped into the yard, her grandmother rushed out with open arms to welcome Jisu warmly.

lines.ko: 따뜻한 방바닥에 앉아 할머니가 구워주신 달콤한 군고구마를 나누어 먹었어요.
lines.en: Sitting on the warm floor, they shared sweet roasted sweet potatoes that grandmother had baked.

lines.ko: 차를 마시던 할머니가 서랍장에서 정성스럽게 싼 보자기 상자를 꺼내오셨어요.
lines.en: While sipping tea, grandmother brought out a box wrapped carefully in a traditional silk cloth.

lines.ko: 손녀의 겨울을 위해 지난 한 달 동안 틈틈이 뜬 선물이라고 수줍게 건네셨어요.
lines.en: She shyly handed it over, saying it was a gift knitted in her spare time over the past month.

lines.ko: 보자기를 풀자 부드러운 개나리색 털실로 짠 도톰한 목도리가 나왔어요.
lines.en: Untying the cloth, a thick wool muffler knitted with soft forsythia-yellow yarn emerged.

lines.ko: 한 올 한 올 고르게 엮인 뜨개질 코마다 할머니의 따뜻한 손길이 느껴졌어요.
lines.en: In every single neatly woven stitch, Jisu could feel her grandmother's loving touch.

lines.ko: 지수는 목도리를 목에 부드럽게 감고 거울 앞으로 다가갔어요.
lines.en: Jisu gently wrapped the muffler around her neck and walked over to the mirror.

lines.ko: 칙칙한 겨울옷 위에 화사한 노란빛 목도리가 꽃처럼 피어났어요.
lines.en: Over her drab winter clothes, the bright yellow muffler bloomed like a lovely flower.

lines.ko: 할머니의 주름진 손을 꼭 잡고 연신 감사하다고 인사드렸어요.
lines.en: Holding her grandmother's wrinkled hands tightly, she thanked her over and over again.

lines.ko: 할머니는 손녀의 따뜻한 미소를 보며 소녀처럼 환하게 웃으셨어요.
lines.en: Looking at her granddaughter's happy smile, grandmother chuckled brightly like a young girl.

lines.ko: 서울로 돌아오는 버스 안에서도 지수는 목도리를 풀지 않았어요.
lines.en: Even on the bus ride back to Seoul, Jisu did not take off the muffler.

lines.ko: 창밖으로 차가운 밤바람이 불었지만 목을 감싼 온기는 식지 않았어요.
lines.en: Cold night winds blew outside the window, but the warmth wrapped around her neck never cooled.

lines.ko: 할머니의 깊은 사랑이 담긴 세상에서 가장 포근한 선물이었어요.
lines.en: It was the coziest gift in the world, filled with her grandmother's deep love.

lines.ko: 지수는 올겨울을 그 어느 때보다 따뜻하게 보낼 수 있을 것 같았어요.

lines.ko: 붉은 벽돌 건물 이층에 자리 잡은 사진관은 아늑하고 고풍스러운 분위기였어요.

lines.en: On the walls hung countless black-and-white portraits of neighbors who had visited over the decades.

lines.ko: 가족 모두 거울 앞에서 옷매무새를 다듬고 머리를 단정하게 빗었어요.
lines.en: Standing before the mirror, the whole family adjusted their clothes and combed their hair neatly.

lines.en: The photographer arranged wooden chairs side by side beneath the large studio lights.

lines.ko: 부모님이 가운데 앉으시고 민수와 동생은 양옆에 바르게 섰어요.
lines.en: His parents sat in the center while Minsu and his younger sibling stood upright on either side.

lines.ko: 카메라 렌즈 앞에 서자 모두 어깨가 굳고 표정이 어색해졌어요.
lines.en: Standing before the camera lens, everyone's shoulders tensed and their faces grew stiff.

lines.ko: 사진사 아저씨가 재미있는 농담을 던지며 긴장을 풀어주셨어요.
lines.en: The photographer cracked a witty joke to help ease their nervous tension.

lines.ko: 그 순간 아버지가 껄껄 웃으셨고 가족 모두 참았던 웃음보가 터졌어요.
lines.en: At that moment, father laughed out loud, and the whole family burst into spontaneous laughter.

lines.ko: 찰칵하는 소리와 함께 환한 플래시 불빛이 눈앞을 밝혔어요.
lines.en: With a crisp clicking sound, the bright studio flash illuminated the room.

lines.ko: 억지로 꾸며낸 미소가 아닌 가장 자연스럽고 행복한 순간이 필름에 담겼어요.
lines.en: Rather than forced smiles, their most natural and joyful moment was captured on film.

lines.ko: 인화된 흑백사진 속에서 네 사람의 웃는 얼굴이 따스하게 빛났어요.
lines.en: In the developed black-and-white print, the smiling faces of the four family members shone warmly.

lines.en: Walking down the studio stairs, the family held the little framed photo with loving care.

lines.ko: 시간에 맞춰 도착하자 한 중년 여성이 자전거를 끌고 다가오셨어요.
lines.en: Arriving on time, she saw a middle-aged woman walking over with the bicycle.

lines.ko: 자전거는 체인에 기름칠도 잘 되어 있고 타이어 바람도 팽팽했어요.
lines.en: The bicycle chain was well-oiled and the tires were properly inflated.

lines.ko: 아주머니는 외국으로 유학을 떠난 딸이 타던 소중한 자전거라고 소개하셨어요.

lines.en: With spring in the air, the local fruit store was selling ripe strawberries at a bargain price.

lines.ko: 모양은 조금 찌그러졌지만 달콤한 향기가 상자 가득 풍겨 나왔어요.

lines.ko: 지수는 딸기 두 상자를 사 들고 민수네 집 주방으로 놀러 갔어요.

lines.ko: 두 사람은 흐르는 찬물에 딸기를 여러 번 깨끗하게 씻었어요.

lines.ko: 초록색 꼭지를 칼로 떼어낸 후 커다란 냄비에 딸기를 가득 담았어요.
lines.en: After trimming off the green stems with a knife, they filled a large pot with the berries.

lines.ko: 위생 장갑을 끼고 손으로 딸기를 주물러 으깨기 시작했어요.
lines.en: Wearing disposable gloves, they began crushing the strawberries with their hands.

lines.ko: 새빨간 과즙이 터져 나오며 주방 가득 상큼한 냄새가 번졌어요.
lines.en: Bright red juice burst out, filling the entire kitchen with a fresh, sweet scent.

lines.ko: 으깬 딸기에 하얀 설탕을 붓고 주걱으로 골고루 섞어주었어요.
lines.en: They poured white sugar over the crushed strawberries and stirred evenly with a spatula.

lines.ko: 냄비를 중간 불에 올리자 거품이 일며 보글보글 끓기 시작했어요.
lines.en: Placing the pot over medium heat, the mixture bubbled up with foam as it came to a boil.

lines.ko: 타지 않도록 나무 주걱으로 바닥을 부지런히 저어주었어요.
lines.en: They stirred the bottom continuously with a wooden spatula so the jam would not burn.

lines.ko: 마지막으로 레몬즙을 몇 방울 떨어뜨리자 색이 더욱 선명해지고 걸쭉해졌어요.
lines.en: Finally, adding a few drops of fresh lemon juice made the color vibrant and the texture thick.

lines.ko: 열탕 소독한 유리병에 따뜻한 딸기잼을 조심스럽게 나누어 담았어요.
lines.en: They carefully poured the warm strawberry jam into sterilized glass jars.

lines.ko: 바삭한 크래커 위에 방금 만든 잼을 듬뿍 얹어 맛을 보았어요.
lines.en: They scooped a generous dollop of fresh jam onto crunchy crackers to taste it.

lines.ko: 시판 제품과는 비교할 수 없을 정도로 깊고 진한 단맛이 입안에 퍼졌어요.
lines.en: A deep, rich sweetness spread across their tongues that store-bought jams could never match.

lines.ko: 정성으로 끓여낸 빨간 잼 병을 보며 두 사람은 흐뭇하게 웃었어요.
lines.en: Looking at the jars of lovingly cooked red jam, the two smiled with deep satisfaction.

title.en: Stargazing from the Rooftop

lines.ko: 맑고 서늘한 가을 저녁에 하나는 민수를 자신의 빌라 옥상으로 초대했어요.
lines.en: On a clear and cool autumn evening, Hana invited Minsu up to the rooftop of her apartment.

lines.ko: 철문을 밀고 나가자 시원한 밤공기와 함께 탁 트인 밤하늘이 펼쳐졌어요.
lines.en: Pushing open the heavy metal door, they were greeted by crisp night air and an expansive open sky.

lines.ko: 둘은 옥상 바닥에 두툼한 돗자리를 펴고 푹신한 담요를 둘렀어요.
lines.en: The two spread a thick mat on the rooftop floor and wrapped themselves in plush blankets.

lines.ko: 보온병에 담아온 따뜻한 핫초코를 머그잔에 따라 서로 건넸어요.
lines.en: Pouring hot cocoa from a thermos into mugs, they handed each other a cup.

lines.ko: 달콤한 김이 모락모락 피어오르는 잔을 두 손으로 감싸 쥐니 손끝이 따뜻했어요.
lines.en: Cradling the mugs with steam gently rising, their fingertips were pleasantly warm.

lines.ko: 도심의 네온사인 불빛 너머로 밤하늘이 짙은 감청색으로 물들었어요.
lines.en: Beyond the glowing city neons, the night sky was dyed in a deep, peaceful navy blue.

lines.ko: 눈을 가늘게 뜨고 올려다보자 어둠 속에서 하나둘 작은 별들이 반짝이기 시작했어요.
lines.en: Squinting their eyes upward, little stars began twinkling one by one in the darkness.

lines.ko: 민수는 손가락으로 북쪽 하늘의 국자 모양 별자리를 가리켰어요.
lines.en: Minsu pointed his finger toward a dipper-shaped constellation in the northern sky.

lines.ko: 하나는 스마트폰 별자리 앱을 비추며 별들의 이름을 찾아보았어요.
lines.en: Hana held up a constellation app on her phone to look up the names of the stars.

lines.ko: 복잡한 도심 한가운데에서도 이렇게 맑은 별빛을 볼 수 있다는 게 신기했어요.
lines.en: It was magical that such bright starlight was visible even in the heart of the busy city.

lines.ko: 두 사람은 잔잔한 밤바람을 맞으며 지난 일 년간의 고민과 꿈을 진솔하게 나누었어요.
lines.en: Basking in the gentle night breeze, the two honestly shared their worries and dreams from the past year.

lines.ko: 서두르지 않고 천천히 걸어가도 괜찮다는 서로의 응원에 마음이 든든해졌어요.
lines.en: Reassuring each other that it is okay to walk slowly without rushing brought great comfort to their hearts.

lines.ko: 어느새 밤하늘 저편에서 작은 별똥별 하나가 길게 꼬리를 끌며 떨어졌어요.
lines.en: Before long, a small shooting star streaked across the far side of the night sky with a long tail.

lines.ko: 두 친구는 두 손을 모으고 마음속으로 소중한 소원을 빌었어요.
lines.en: The two friends folded their hands and made heartfelt wishes in their minds.

lines.ko: 별빛 아래에서 깊어가는 가을밤은 오래도록 잊지 못할 추억이 되었어요.
lines.en: Deepening beneath the starlight, the autumn night became an unforgettable memory.
